function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Below is a quick snapshot of the **next major festivals in the United States** (sorted by the earliest upcoming date after Sep 29 2026).  All dates are for the 2027 calendar year; check the official sites for the most up‑to‑date ticketing and travel information.

| # | Festival | Dates (2027) | Location | What to Expect | Ticketing |
|---|----------|--------------|----------|----------------|-----------|
| 1 | **Burning Man** | **Sep 1 – Sep 9** | Black Rock City, Nevada (Black Rock Desert) | An immersive art‑and‑culture event in the desert featuring large-scale installations, music, dance, and a “leave‑no‑trace” ethos. | Early‑bird (Feb – Mar), General (Apr – Jun), Late‑bird (Jul – Aug). |
| 2 | **South by Southwest (SXSW)** | **Mar 10 – Mar 19** | Austin, Texas | A multi‑disciplinary festival covering music, film, interactive media, and tech. | Early‑bird (Oct – Dec 2026), General (Jan – Feb 2027). |
| 3 | **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | **Apr 12 – Apr 15** | Indio, California | Two‑weekend music and arts festival featuring top‑tier artists, art installations, and a vibrant pop‑culture vibe. | Early‑bird (Oct – Dec 2026), General (Jan – Feb 2027). |
| 4 | **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | **Apr 28 – May 1** | New Orleans, Louisiana | Celebrates jazz, blues, and Creole culture with live music, food, and parades. | Early‑bird (Oct – Dec 2026), General (Jan – Feb 2027). |
| 5 | **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** | **Jun 1 – Jun 4** | Manchester, Tennessee | A four‑day festival featuring a wide range of music genres, art, and wellness activities. | Early‑bird (Oct – Dec 2026), General (Jan – Feb 2027). |
| 6 | **Taste of Chicago** | **Jun 15 – Jun 18** | Chicago, Illinois | Food‑centric festival with chefs, cooking demos, and live entertainment. | General (Jan – Feb 2027). |
| 7 | **Summerfest** | **Jul 1 – Jul 4** | Milwaukee, Wisconsin | One of the world’s largest music festivals, spanning multiple venues across the city. | Early‑bird (Oct – Dec 2026), General (Jan – Feb 2027). |
| 8 | **Electric Daisy Carnival (EDC) Las Vegas** | **Aug 11 – Aug 13** | Las Vegas, Nevada | Massive EDM festival with elaborate stages, light shows, and carnival rides. | Early‑bird (Oct – Dec 2026), General (Jan – Feb 2027). |
| 9 | **New York Film Festival** | **Sep 1 – Sep 10** | New York City, New York | Premier film festival showcasing international cinema, retrospectives, and Q&A sessions. | Early‑bird (Oct – Dec 2026), General (Jan – Feb 2027). |
|10 | **Oktoberfest (Chicago)** | **Oct 1 – Oct 10** | Chicago, Illinois | German‑style beer festival with live music, food, and cultural activities. | General (Jan – Feb 2027). |

### How to Pick the Right Festival

| Preference | Suggested Festival |
|------------|--------------------|
| **Music‑centric, large‑scale** | Coachella, Bonnaroo, EDC Las Vegas |
| **Art & Culture in a unique setting** | Burning Man |
| **Film & Indie Cinema** | New York Film Festival |
| **Jazz & Heritage** | New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival |
| **Family‑friendly food & music** | Taste of Chicago, Summerfest |
| **Tech & Interactive** | SXSW |

### Quick Tips

1. **Book Early** – Most festivals sell out months in advance.  
2. **Travel & Accommodation** – Book lodging 2–3 months ahead; consider staying off‑site and using local hotels or Airbnb.  
3. **Transportation** – Many festivals offer shuttle services; otherwise, plan for parking or public transit.  
4. **Health & Safety** – Check the festival’s COVID‑19 or health guidelines (if any) and bring a reusable water bottle (many festivals now provide refill stations).  
5. **Packing** – Bring layers, a rain poncho (especially for desert or outdoor festivals), sunscreen, and a small first‑aid kit.

---

#### Want More Details?

- **Burning Man** – [burningman.org](https://burningman.org)  
- **SXSW** – [sxsw.com](https://www.sxsw.com)  
- **Coachella** – [coachella.com](https://www.coachella.com)  
- **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** – [jazz.org](https://www.jazz.org)  
- **Bonnaroo** – [bonnaroo.com](https://www.bonnaroo.com)  
- **Taste of Chicago** – [tasteofchicago.com](https://www.tasteofchicago.com)  
- **Summerfest** – [summerfest.com](https://www.summerfest.com)  
- **EDC Las Vegas** – [edc.com](https://www.edc.com)  
- **New York Film Festival** – [nyff.org](https://www.nyff.org)  
- **Chicago Oktoberfest** – [oktoberfest.com](https://www.oktoberfest.com)

Let me know if you’d like a deeper dive into any particular festival, or if you’re looking for something more niche (e.g., food, craft, or regional festivals). Happy planning!
